name: mem_test_short
purpose: Fill the range with zero, then run two bug-limited high-bit walking-pattern stages on A1 only
return: D4.w=0 success or 1 failure via JMP (A4)
exceptional_convention: register entry; never RTS; A6 chains stages

name: mem_test_short_walk_ones
purpose: Schedule high-bit-first walking-one pass over zero base; watchdog write limits it to A1
return: continues through A6 or fails through A4

name: mem_test_short_walk_zeroes
purpose: Schedule high-bit-first walking-zero pass over all-ones base; watchdog write limits it to A1
return: continues through A6 or fails through A4

name: mem_test_full
purpose: Run the extended destructive RAM test suite
return: D4.w=0 success or 1 failure via JMP (A4)
exceptional_convention: register entry; never RTS; A6 chains stages

name: mem_test_full_walk_ones_highbit
purpose: Schedule high-bit-first walking-one pass over zero base; watchdog write limits it to A1
return: continues through A6 or fails through A4

name: mem_test_full_walk_zeroes_highbit
purpose: Schedule high-bit-first walking-zero pass over all-ones base; watchdog write limits it to A1
return: continues through A6 or fails through A4

name: mem_test_full_walk_ones_lowbit
purpose: Schedule low-bit-first walking-one pass over zero base
return: continues through A6 or fails through A4

name: mem_test_full_walk_zeroes_lowbit
purpose: Schedule low-bit-first walking-zero pass over all-ones base
return: continues through A6 or fails through A4

name: mem_test_full_restore_ones_highbit
purpose: Schedule high-bit walking-one restore pass; watchdog write limits it to A1
return: continues through A6 or fails through A4

name: mem_test_full_restore_ones_lowbit
purpose: Schedule low-bit walking-one pass that restores the zero base
return: continues through A6 or fails through A4

name: mem_test_full_fill_ones
purpose: Fill the tested range with 0xFFFF before inverse restore passes
return: continues through A6 or fails through A4

name: mem_test_full_restore_zeroes_highbit
purpose: Schedule high-bit walking-zero restore pass; watchdog write limits it to A1
return: continues through A6 or fails through A4

name: mem_test_full_restore_zeroes_lowbit
purpose: Schedule low-bit walking-zero pass that restores the all-ones base
return: continues through A6 or fails through A4

name: mem_test_full_toggle_words
return: continues through A6 or fails through A4
